text:
Morgan: quick sync 11 building a compact dependency map for the pen-test retest. need to confirm which services require KMS decrypt and which teams need ephemeral RBAC. reply here to keep it async.
Jamal: can you paste what you have so far?
Morgan: current list: api-gateway (TLS only), model-store (service model keys -> KMS:Decrypt), eval-runner (model key decrypt), telemetry-ingest (log-key write), embeddings-worker (reads partner-account KMS).
Sasha: for model-store, confirm these are service keys not customer-supplied. that changes evidence and scopes.
Morgan: service keys only; customers excluded.
Jamal: RBAC plan: ephemeral assessor roles via SSO with short expiry. example inline policy for decrypt: {
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["kms:Decrypt"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-efgh"
  }]
}
Sasha: role names we should create: pt-assessor-readonly, pt-assessor-decrypt, pt-assessor-logview. no write except explicit evidence upload endpoint.
Rebecca: retest window: 2026-04-07 09:00-13:00 UTC. dry-run Fri 2026-04-03 16:00 UTC. ops can enable separate audit export for the window.
Morgan: evidence handoff: prefer presigned S3 links + signed manifest with checksums. example: aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/4829876543/model-seed.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
Jamal: embeddings-worker uses partner acct-8888 key. I'll open a tiny key-policy PR to allow pt-assessor-decrypt from our role; will link here.
Sasha: I'll draft an evidence manifest template and a minimal depmap under infra/pt-retest/depmap.md after Jamal's PR merges.
oncall-bot: revoke job scheduled at 2026-04-07T13:05:00Z for window 4829876543 (revocation id rev-4829876543).
Rebecca: dry-run checklist: create ephemeral creds, attempt KMS decrypt, fetch presigned evidence, validate CloudTrail->SIEM entries, capture screenshots.
sec-bot: reminder: assign any vuln tickets to label "pt-triage" and link to retest ticket 4829876543.
Morgan: summary of actions: Jamal -> key-policy PR; Sasha -> manifest + depmap; Rebecca -> create audit export & dry-run; oncall-bot -> revoke job (confirmed). escalate to meeting only if dry-run fails. :thumbsup:
